import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

B62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L=B62.strip().split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); BL={}
for l in L[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return BL.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+(i-1)*ge; pX[i,0]=1 if i>1 else 0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+(j-1)*ge; pY[0,j]=2 if j>1 else 0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]; Mi1=M[i-1];Xi1=Ix[i-1];Yi1=Iy[i-1];Mi=M[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(a,s2[j-1]); o=(Mi1[j-1]+s,Xi1[j-1]+s,Yi1[j-1]+s); k=0
            if o[1]>o[k]:k=1
            if o[2]>o[k]:k=2
            Mi[j]=o[k];pM[i,j]=k
            if Mi1[j]+go>=Xi1[j]+ge: Xi[j]=Mi1[j]+go;pX[i,j]=0
            else: Xi[j]=Xi1[j]+ge;pX[i,j]=1
            if Mi[j-1]+go>=Yi[j-1]+ge: Yi[j]=Mi[j-1]+go;pY[i,j]=0
            else: Yi[j]=Yi[j-1]+ge;pY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append("-");ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: a1.append("-");a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))

def seqof(a):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90).json()["sequence"]["value"]

PCSK={"BLI-4/KPC-4":"P51559","KPC-1":"O17798","EGL-3/KPC-2":"G5ECN9","AEX-5/KPC-3":"P91863"}
FUR=seqof("P09958")
SQ={k:seqof(v) for k,v in PCSK.items()}

sites={153:"triad Asp",194:"triad His",368:"triad Ser",295:"oxyanion Asn",
       253:"S1 Ser253",258:"S1 Asp258",301:"S1 Asp301",306:"S1 Asp306",
       236:"S4 Glu236",254:"S4 Trp254",264:"S4 Asp264",308:"Tyr308"}
rows=[]
for name,acc in PCSK.items():
    s=SQ[name]
    A1,A2=nw(s,FUR)      # full-length global alignment
    pi=pj=0; f2x={}; ident=0; alen=0
    for x,y in zip(A1,A2):
        if x!="-": pi+=1
        if y!="-": pj+=1
        if x!="-" and y!="-":
            f2x[pj]=pi; alen+=1; ident+= (x==y)
    rec=dict(protease=name,acc=acc,L=len(s),pct_id_vs_furin=round(100*ident/alen,1))
    ncons=0
    for p,lab in sites.items():
        q=f2x.get(p); r=s[q-1] if q else None
        rec[lab]=f"{r}{q}" if q else "-"
        if r==FUR[p-1]: ncons+=1
    rec["n_conserved_of_12"]=ncons
    rows.append(rec)
P=pd.DataFrame(rows)
cols_order=["protease","acc","L","pct_id_vs_furin","n_conserved_of_12"]+list(sites.values())
pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print(P[cols_order].to_string(index=False))
P.to_csv("worm_PCSK_paralog_pocket_conservation.csv",index=False)

# ---------- DPY-14 and a few more collagens: does the motif extend? ----------
def usearch(q):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,gene_names,sequence","format":"json","size":5},timeout=90)
    return [(e["primaryAccession"],
             ";".join(g.get("geneName",{}).get("value","") for g in e.get("genes",[])),
             e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in r.json().get("results",[])]
extra={}
for g in ["dpy-14","col-12","col-13","rol-8","sqt-3"]:
    h=usearch(f'(gene:{g}) AND (taxonomy_id:6239)')
    if h: extra[g]=h[0]
def gxy1(seq,minrep=4):
    for i in range(len(seq)-3*minrep):
        if all(seq[i+3*t]=="G" for t in range(minrep)): return i+1
    return len(seq)
print("\nAdditional collagens:")
for g,(a,gn,s) in extra.items():
    fg=gxy1(s); found=[(m.group(1),m.start()+4,s[m.start()+4:m.start()+8])
                        for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))',s) if m.start()+4<fg]
    print("  %-8s %-10s L=%3d firstGXY=%3d  %s"%(g,a,len(s),fg,found))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.barh(P.protease,P.n_conserved_of_12,color="#4C78A8")
ax.set_xlim(0,12); ax.set_xlabel("furin catalytic + S1/S4 pocket residues conserved (of 12)")
ax.set_title("All four C. elegans PCSKs share the furin-type R-X-X-R recognition apparatus")
for i,(n,v) in enumerate(zip(P.protease,P.n_conserved_of_12)): ax.text(v+0.1,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
